decision_rule: As in round 1 and R2-A. Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting or fact to the plant through a location shared by several sites (campus rule, consultation 10), or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked before calling a JSON-LD quote missing). Confirmed = the cited page, or for a multi-row claim a sibling row's page opened 2026-11-16, carries every additive clause. Not additive: limiting parentheticals ('as of Mar 2015', 'company-level'), technical glosses, and rubric labels that match the scored level (a label that asserts a level the coordinator ruled unsupported, as ESCO's 'custom', is a judgement). A plants.csv field that carries a clause no evidence row supports is corrected through its row's plants_csv_value (ground rule 1). Opening lines: every clause carried by a stated row of a claim named in the reasoning; ends in a 'you' question; no pitch language; the question asks rather than presumes a fact no stated row shows (NNS Norfolk precedent). Labor: each counted posting re-read live today on the employer's own board.
error_rate_note: 5/143 = 3.5%. Denominator: 110 in-scope stated rows (delegated fields for the 10 plants plus the 4 stated v-mining-heavy-equipment:demand_outlook rows cited by every demand score) + 23 cited inferred/unknown rows (incl. the Stage A outlook placeholder) + 10 opening lines. On stated rows plus opening lines only: 5/120 = 4.2%. Without the TAG products row (a correct row whose plants.csv field drifted): 4/143 = 2.8%. The 5: Paladin name and address rest on an inferred EPA identity join tagged stated (2 rows, one root cause); ESCO production_type's 'custom' label contradicts consultation 10; Bobcat Bismarck's opening line presumes hand welding at the facility; TAG plants.csv products carries an unsourced parenthetical. No correction changes a score point. Round 1 (checker C) found 29/155 = 18.7% on these plants. Field drift and score rulings are reported separately, outside the numerator.

(b) A production_type label that asserts a level the coordinator ruled unsupported (ESCO 'custom'). (c) A plants.csv field carrying a clause no row supports (TAG products). method: Scope built by script from ledger/evidence.csv as it stands: every stated row of the delegated fields for the 10 plants; every row (any tag) of each claim named after 'supporting claims:' in their score_* rows (incl. the 5 v-mining-heavy-equipment:demand_outlook rows); and the 10 opening_line rows. Total 143. All 57 distinct source URLs were fetched fresh on 2026-11-16 with tools/fetch_page.fetch(with_raw=True) into a new scratch directory: plain requests, with headless Chromium for UltiPro, Workday, Paycom and Weir. All returned 200. Each '...'-joined fragment of all 117 quoted rows was matched against normalised visible text plus raw source: 117 found, 0 missing. Additive clauses not inside quotes were grepped on the same pages: dates, ZIPs, pay, shifts, names, cut-sheet column headers. Boards read live today: Epiroc search (locationsearch=Ooltewah); Werk-Brau Paycom career page plus JSON-LD of jobs 556209 and 608999; Virnig and Rockland Paylocity pageData JSON; Doosan job pages and welder searches for Litchfield and Bismarck; Weir Workday CXS (canApply, startDate, descriptor); Federal Signal UltiPro opportunity; Curry ADP requisitions API. Site checks: EPA FRS name and registry queries; ECHO DFR for Werk-Brau 616 N Blanchard (RCRA Inactive) and Curry Jones St (same handler as 1477 DeGol); Census geocoder for 2500, 2800 and 4000 Fostoria Ave and 6989 and 7080 Discovery Dr; FRS coordinates for distances. score_notes.why: RULING. Consultation 10: buildings within about 1 km doing the same production are one campus, recorded as one plant. TAG's two Discovery Dr facilities are about 334 m apart (FRS coordinates) and both are manufacturing space, so the record is a single-plant company: 'multi-plant parent' fails, and 70+ employees is under 100. Total 21 -> 16, Low. The ROHN precedent ('two Peoria divisions are two physical plants') predates consultation 10 and had two ledger records. Alternative branch: if they are two plants, scale 5 stands but part mix 8 -> 0, because production_type is a company-level statement over two sites in one city (shared-city rule); total 13.
